canonicalIdentityAuthorization.rule: identity, workspace authority, membership, role and permission truth remains EKODI-controlled

serviceOperational.rule: service operational state belongs to the owning declared boundary and crosses boundaries only by contract

externalProviderRaw.rule: raw provider data remains at the provider where practical; EKODI stores only purpose-bound projections and connection metadata

projectionCache.rule: cache, UI projection and analytics copies never become authority for identity, authorization or source records
